title: Unable to log in
description: Customer receives an invalid credentials error despite entering the correct password.

title: Payment failed during checkout
description: Payment is declined during checkout, but the customer's bank confirms sufficient funds.

title: Request to reset password
description: Customer did not receive the password reset email after multiple attempts.

title: Dashboard loading slowly
description: The analytics dashboard takes more than 30 seconds to load.

title: Update billing information
description: Customer wants to update the credit card associated with their subscription.

title: Incorrect invoice amount
description: The latest invoice includes an unexpected charge that does not match the subscription plan.

title: Application crashes on startup
description: The desktop application crashes immediately after launch following the latest update.

title: Unable to upload attachments
description: Uploading PDF attachments fails with a server error for files larger than 5 MB.

title: Request account deletion
description: Customer requests permanent deletion of their account and associated personal data.

title: Email notifications not received
description: Customer no longer receives email notifications for account activity and updates.

title: Data export failed
description: Exporting customer records to CSV fails with a timeout error.

title: Feature request for dark mode
description: Customer requests a dark mode option to improve usability in low-light environments.
